description: This Java class defines the 'ThingDefinitionModifiedStrategy', a strategy for handling 'ThingDefinitionModified' events in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It extends an abstract strategy class and implements the application of the event to modify a 'ThingBuilder' object.

classes.name: ThingDefinitionModifiedStrategy
classes.description: A final class that extends AbstractThingEventStrategy for handling 'ThingDefinitionModified' events, applying modifications to a 'ThingBuilder' instance.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Overrides the method to apply a 'ThingDefinitionModified' event to a 'ThingBuilder', updating its definition.
